Lightning Talk: The BS Principle - John Pavan - CppCon 2025
---

The BS principle explains how to overcome differences in specialized knowledge and is the best piece of advice I’ve ever been given. If you need to understand a complex topic quickly, it provides a framework to integrate an expert and gain the necessary information, or discover that their answer was just BS. Additionally, you can apply the principle to explaining a topic and convince others that your idea or proposal is the one that should be accepted. The BS principle will be demonstrated to (hopefully) explain a concept from Nuclear Physics to the audience.
